program.section_heading: English as a Second Language - Noncredit Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Improve overall fluency and competency in English, with the goal of exiting the program at an advanced level of English.
Demonstrate listening comprehension of topics and a variety of material in the course.
Demonstrate strategies that are consistent with being active and independent learners.
Demonstrate ability to read appropriate level readings out loud.
Recognize and use grammatical structures in English appropriate for the level of the course.
Students will demonstrate an understanding of American geography, culture, norms, and democracy
Engage in conversation in English appropriate to the course level.
Use stress, rhythm, intonation and sounds of Standard American English to express themselves clearly.
Use a variety of oral skills when interacting with an audience or small group.
Write for a variety of personal, workplace, and academic purposes in which English is the primary language.
Demonstrate comprehension of reading passages in which English is the primary language.
Apply strategies to build vocabulary from reading contexts and use vocabulary expansion skills.

notes: The catalog counts this award in hours; all units fields hold hours as printed (ranges shown as units/units_max).

Required Core - Choose one group (192.00-216.00 hours): Group 1 and Group 2 are recorded as separate blocks in option_group 'Required Core'. ESL 642 and ESL 652 appear in both groups; Group 2 replaces ESL 632 with ESL 632A and ESL 632B.
The sixth outcome is printed without a terminal period and begins 'Students will demonstrate...'; copied as printed.
The outcomes are printed under the program's Program Learning Outcomes heading for this Certificate of Competency.
Award is printed as 'Noncredit Certificate of Competency (NCCC)'.
